title: SPXL timing-signal search: frozen test specification
status: Frozen at the end of the Train phase, before unsealing. The Test phase takes every number it needs from this file and changes none of them.
governing_document: research/PREREGISTRATION.md governs (research/prereg.json is its machine-readable copy). This file adds the quantities section 8 lets the Train phase set and fixes, before unsealing, the implementation details the plan leaves open ('interpretations').
hash_file: research/FROZEN_HASH.txt (SHA-256 of this file's bytes); the same bytes are output/research/train_params.json, whose SHA-256 research/TRAIN_REPORT.md records

inputs.note: on a mismatch of a pinned or predictor-input hash the Test phase stops. The train quantities were computed from panel_train.pkl above. panel_test.pkl was not opened or hashed by the Train phase; the Test phase uses the panel built by `build` from the inputs above (if it rebuilds it with `build --offline`, the rebuilt panel_train.pkl must match the hash above). The code and panel_meta.json hashes at train time are in research/train_results.md (provenance only)

calendar.sessions: trading days of scripts/backtest_rating.build_daily(inputs, Config()) from the pinned rating_inputs.pkl (^SP500TR calendar)
calendar.origin: last session of each calendar month (backtest_rating.month_end_positions), 1990-01-31..2026-08-31
calendar.t_minus: the session immediately before the origin; daily market inputs of C01-C10 use values dated on or before t-; C11 and C12 use data dated t as in the backtest
calendar.position: decision at origin t implemented at the close of t; outcome window sessions t+1..t+h

split.train_origins: month-ends from 1990-01-31 whose window's last session <= 2007-12-31
split.test_origins: month-ends from 2008-01-31 whose window's last session <= 2026-09-25
split.embargo: origins between the two belong to neither

calendar.test_origin_rule: month-end origins from 2008-01-31 whose h-session window's last session is on or before 2026-09-25 (h = 126 for the primary test and F4; 63 for F3, F5, F7; 21 for F2, F6)

definitions.R_bill: prod over i=t+1..t+h of (1 + tbill_ret_i) - 1; tbill_ret = previous day's DGS3MO / 252 (build_daily)
definitions.Y: fund[t+h]/fund[t] - 1 - R_bill(t,h); fund = synthetic 3x through 2008-12-31, SPXL from 2009-01-02 (backtest excess_h)
definitions.D20: 1 if min over i=t+1..t+63 of fund[i]/fund[t] <= 0.8 else 0 (backtest real_dd20_63)

standardisation.formula: z_jt = (x_jt - mu_j) / sd_j; mu_j, sd_j (ddof = 1) over the parameter-window month-ends at which x_j is available
standardisation.note: C10-C12 are reported only: they are not composite members

composite.formula: COMP_t = mean over members j available at t of clip(s_j * (x_jt - mu_j) / sd_j, -3, 3); missing if fewer than 7 of the 9 members are available
composite.tau_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if COMP_t >= tau (the 33.33rd percentile of COMP over the parameter window), else T-bills
composite.tau_median_use: secondary economic analysis only: the composite rule with the threshold at the train median (section 11)

tau_j.use: the economic rule of any candidate that passes the primary test, and the secondary table of all 12 candidates

vol_managed.c_definition: median of IVAR_t = C10 over the parameter window
vol_managed.w_bar_definition: mean of min(1, c / IVAR_t) over the parameter window
vol_managed.rule: SPXL weight w_t = min(1, c / IVAR_t) at each test origin, the rest T-bills; against BH and against the constant weight w_bar (secondary, not clean: uses the VIX level)

sloos_lag_branch.source: ALFRED first-release dates of DRTSCILM only (build phase, panel_meta.json)

candidates.name: Variance risk premium
candidates.definition: VIX(t-)^2/12 - RV21(t-); RV21 = sum over the 21 sessions ending at t- of (100*ln(G_i/G_{i-1}))^2, G = ^GSPC close; percent squared per month
candidates.exposure: partial: uses the VIX; premium negative after crashes (2008, 2020 known)
candidates.ta_flag: realised variance used only as a sign-blind risk measure (allowed, flagged)
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if +1 * C01_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Real-time output gap
candidates.definition: INDPRO vintage in effect on origin date t (realtime_start=realtime_end=t); m = latest observation month; OLS ln IP_k = a + b*k + c*k^2 over months from max(1948-01, first observation) through m; GAP = residual at m; re-estimated at every origin
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if -1 * C02_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: 12-month change in the 3-month Treasury yield
candidates.definition: DGS3MO(t-) - DGS3MO(t'-), t' = the origin 12 month-ends earlier; percentage points
candidates.ta_flag: none (interest rate; 12-month change chosen so no moving-average construct appears)
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if -1 * C03_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Term spread
candidates.exposure: inverted-curve penalty was inside the full-sample drift test (not isolated)
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if +1 * C04_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Default spread (Baa minus Aaa)
candidates.definition: DBAA(t-) - DAAA(t-); percentage points; level only
candidates.exposure: close to clean (HY penalty could not fire before 2023-09)
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if +1 * C05_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: CPI inflation, year on year
candidates.definition: CPIAUCNS vintage in effect on origin date t; m = latest observation month; ln(CPI_m/CPI_{m-12}); if CPI_{m-12} missing carry forward the previous origin's value; never interpolate. Fallback if ALFRED fails: m = latest published month <= origin month minus one
candidates.exposure: 2021-23 inflation and 2022 bear market known; CPI>3.5% penalty inside the drift test
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if -1 * C06_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Net share of banks tightening C&I lending standards
candidates.definition: FRED DRTSCILM from the latest observation usable at t, held constant between releases; an observation dated at the start of quarter q is usable from the last session of the first month after quarter q ends (e.g. 1990-04-01 usable from 1990-07-31)
candidates.exposure: clean apart from general knowledge; the returns paper's sample includes 2008
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if -1 * C07_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Initial jobless claims, year on year
candidates.definition: w = latest week-ending Saturday with w + 5 days <= t; ln(sum ICNSA weeks w-3..w) - ln(sum ICNSA weeks w-55..w-52)
candidates.exposure: 2008 and 2020 spikes known; 2020 capped by the composite clip
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if -1 * C08_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Excess CAPE yield
candidates.definition: q = backtest_rating.reported_quarter(t); m = latest CPIAUCNS month in the vintage at t; CAPE = (P(t-)/CPI_m) / mean over k=q-119..q of (E_k/CPI_k); RR10 = DGS10(t-)/100 - ((CPI_m/CPI_{m-120})^(1/10) - 1); ECY = 1/CAPE - RR10; P = ^GSPC close; E = Shiller trailing 12-month earnings; Shiller's own CAPE / ECY columns not used; level only
candidates.exposure: partial: valuation drift added no 6-month skill; valuation term added nothing 1881-2026; 2010s known
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if +1 * C09_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Implied variance (VIX squared)
candidates.exposure: NOT CLEAN: VIX spikes followed by rebounds seen; hurdle (mostly VIX) seen to have no timing value
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if -1 * C10_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Leverage-cost hurdle (spxlcast/assess.py)
candidates.definition: column hurdle of the pinned rating_backtest.csv at origin t: exp((fees + 2*(3m bill + 0.75%))/3 + 1.5*sigma_1y^2) - 1 via spxlcast.assess.leverage_cost
candidates.exposure: NOT CLEAN: full-sample tercile results and (per brief) rank correlation about -0.03 seen
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if -1 * C11_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

candidates.name: Retired rating score (spxlcast/rating.py)
candidates.definition: column score of the pinned rating_backtest.csv at origin t: mean of clip(annualised 6-month median excess return / 15%) and clip(annualised Sharpe-like ratio / 0.5), full model, no news
candidates.exposure: NOT CLEAN: full-sample 6-month rank correlation -0.03 and half-sample threshold behaviour seen
candidates.secondary_rule: hold SPXL at origin t if +1 * C12_t >= tau_j, else T-bills

primary_test.sample: test origins for h = 126 (2008-01-31..2026-02-27, 218) at which the predictor and Y(t,126) both exist
primary_test.n_eff: spxlcast.evaluation.effective_n(session positions (panel column pos) of the sample's origins, 126)
primary_test.p_one_sided: 1 - Phi(z) (scipy.stats.norm.sf(z)); p = 1 if r is undefined or n_eff <= 4; p = 0 if r = 1

correction.rule: sort p ascending (ties in the order C01..C12, COMP); reject H_(i) while p_(i) <= 0.05 / (13 - i + 1); stop at the first failure
correction.adjusted_p: running maximum of min(1, (13 - i + 1) * p_(i))

primary_test.pass: a hypothesis rejected by Holm is a primary statistical pass for that predictor
primary_test.not_tested_rule: a candidate whose data cannot be built is 'not tested': K stays 13 and its p is 1

secondary_tests.same_as_primary: predictors, statistic, n_eff (with the family's h), one-sided p, 90% interval; Holm within each family of 13
secondary_tests.replication: the primary test and F2-F7 on train origins, reported beside the test period as published-sample replication (research/train_results.md holds the train side)

economic_test.rule: at each test origin t from 2008-01-31 through 2026-07-31 hold the realised fund (backtest_rating.build_daily column fund_ret: the synthetic 3x fund through 2008-12-31, SPXL from 2009-01-02) from the close of t to the close of the next month-end if COMP_t >= tau, else T-bills (tbill_ret)
economic_test.holding_sessions: the holding decided at the origin with session position a, followed by the month-end at position b, earns the daily returns of sessions a+1..b
economic_test.switch_cost_application: a switch between SPXL and T-bills multiplies wealth by (1 - 0.001) at the start of the first session of the new holding: that session's return is (1 - 0.001) * (1 + r) - 1
economic_test.initial_allocation: free for every strategy (rule, MIX_w, vol-managed, constant w_bar), as for BH: costs apply only to changes between consecutive holdings
economic_test.missing_signal: keep the previous holding (the count is reported); T-bills if the signal is missing at the first origin

benchmarks.BH: buy-and-hold the realised fund over the same sessions, no cost
benchmarks.MIX_w: w in the realised fund and 1 - w in T-bills, w = (number of the 223 holdings in SPXL) / 223; the two sleeves drift within each month and are rebalanced to w at each month-end close; cost 0.001 * |w - w_pre| on the first session of the new month (w_pre = the fund's weight just before rebalancing), applied as the switch cost

metrics.daily_returns: fund_ret and tbill_ret with a missing value treated as 0, as backtest_rating.strategy_section
metrics.CAGR: W_N^(252 / N) - 1, W the wealth after the N sessions 2008-02-01..2026-08-31 (W_0 = 1)
metrics.Sharpe: mean / sd (ddof = 1) of the daily (return - tbill_ret) * sqrt(252)
metrics.max_drawdown: max over sessions of 1 - W_t / max_{s <= t} W_s over the wealth path W_1..W_N, as backtest_rating.strategy_section

pass_all_of.E4: Sharpe(rule) > Sharpe(BH) within sessions 2008-02-01..2016-12-30 and within 2017-01-03..2026-08-31

economic_test.E4_method: Sharpe of the full-period daily return series restricted to each half's sessions (the strategies are not restarted)
economic_test.also_applied_to: every candidate that passes the primary test, with its own tau_j (hold SPXL if s_j * x_jt >= tau_j) and the same criteria; for all 12 candidates as a secondary table

secondary_descriptive.costs: the composite rule with 0 and 0.0025 switching costs
secondary_descriptive.median_threshold: the composite rule with COMP_t >= tau_median

stationary_bootstrap.what: 90% intervals for Sharpe(rule) - Sharpe(BH) and CAGR(rule) - CAGR(BH)
stationary_bootstrap.data: the 223 monthly holding-period returns of the rule and of BH (costs included) and the monthly T-bill holding-period returns, resampled as aligned triples
stationary_bootstrap.algorithm: rng = numpy.random.default_rng(20260927); U = rng.random((10000, 223)); S = rng.integers(0, 223, size=(10000, 223)); idx[:, 0] = S[:, 0]; for i >= 1: idx[:, i] = S[:, i] where U[:, i] < 1/6 else (idx[:, i-1] + 1) mod 223 (Politis-Romano, circular, mean block 6 months)
stationary_bootstrap.statistics: monthly Sharpe = mean / sd (ddof = 1) of (r - r_bill) * sqrt(12); CAGR = prod(1 + r)^(12 / 223) - 1
stationary_bootstrap.interval: numpy.percentile of the 10000 differences at 5 and 95 (linear)

secondary_descriptive.vol_managed: w_t = min(1, c / IVAR_t) at each test origin (IVAR = C10), rest T-bills; sleeves drift within the month; cost 0.001 * |w_t - w_pre|; if IVAR_t is missing the previous target weight is kept; compared with BH and with a constant w_bar under the same mechanics
secondary_descriptive.descriptives: time in SPXL, number of switches, turnover (sum of |weight traded|), total costs paid

halves.label: 'one half only' if r is not positive in both

robustness.episode_method: drop the origins whose month lies in the episode (inclusive); r, n_eff (of the remaining positions) and one-sided p recomputed; 'episode-dependent' if p > 0.10 for any one episode

moving_block_bootstrap.what: 90% interval for the primary r of each predictor
moving_block_bootstrap.algorithm: for each predictor a fresh rng = numpy.random.default_rng(20260927); the predictor's primary sample in origin order (n rows); k = ceil(n / 12) blocks per resample; starts = rng.integers(0, n - 12 + 1, size=(10000, k)); each resample is the concatenation of rows start..start+11 of its k blocks, cut to n rows; r_b = spearman on the resample
moving_block_bootstrap.interval: numpy.percentile of the finite r_b at 5 and 95 (linear)

robustness.expanding_window_composite: at each origin t, mu_j(t) and sd_j(t) (ddof = 1) over the month-ends from 1990-01-31 through t inclusive at which x_j is available; member j is available at t only if x_jt exists and it has at least 60 such values; then the section 7 formula (clip 3, at least 7 members); its primary r is reported
robustness.partial_spearman: controls ln VIX(t-) (ln of panel column vix_tm) and DGS3MO(t-) (panel column y3_tm): average ranks of s_P * P, Y(t,126) and both controls over the rows where all four exist; OLS of rank(s_P * P) and of rank(Y) on [1, rank(ln VIX), rank(DGS3MO)]; the partial r is the Pearson correlation of the two residual vectors; one-sided p as section 9 with n_eff - 5 in place of n_eff - 3; for primary-passing predictors (reported for all)
robustness.synthetic_spread: rebuild the daily frame with dataclasses.replace(Config(), swap_spread = 0.0025) and 0.0125 (only fund returns before 2009-01-02 change); recompute Y(t,126) and the 13 primary r and p (reported only)

verdict.condition: primary Holm pass AND economic pass
verdict.label: Timing signal confirmed
Predictive, not usable by the registered rule

verdict.condition: composite economic pass, no primary pass
verdict.label: Not confirmed (gain could be luck); candidate for a new pre-registration on future data only

robustness_labels.episode-dependent: one-sided p > 0.10 when any one episode's origins are left out
robustness_labels.one half only: r not positive in both halves (origins 2008-01..2016-12 and 2017-01..2026-02)

sanity_checks_test_phase: pinned inputs, predictor_inputs.pkl, prereg files, this file and train_params.json match their recorded hashes
target reproduction at all origins: rebuilt Y, S and D20 equal the pinned CSV's excess_h, sp_h - tbill_h and real_dd20_63 (tolerance 1e-9)

legacy reproduction: spearman(score, Y(t,126)) over every month-end 1990-01-31..2026-02-27 with both (the pinned CSV's score column, as the README computed it, so the two D5 origins are included) is -0.03 +/- 0.01, else fixed as a deviation before anything is interpreted
synthetic fund: daily correlation of syn_ret with spxl_ret from 2009-01-02 where both exist (backtest_rating.validate_synthetic) is at least 0.99
coverage: non-missing share of every candidate and of COMP at test origins; below 90% at h = 126 flags that predictor's test
look log summarised in the results
test_phase_preconditions: verify_unseal: the token, research/PREREG_HASH.txt, and output/research/train_params.json against research/TRAIN_REPORT.md
research/frozen_spec.json against research/FROZEN_HASH.txt, and byte-identical to output/research/train_params.json
run once; afterwards only bug fixes, reporting original and corrected results (DEVIATIONS.md)
interpretations: I1 tau and tau_j use q = 33.33 exactly as registered (not 100/3)
I2 COMP averages the available clipped signed z-scores with equal weight; it is missing below 7 members
I3 holdings, switch costs, initial allocation and missing signals as in economic_test above
I4 MIX_w and the vol-managed rules drift within the month and pay 0.001 x |weight traded| at each month-end rebalance
I5 metrics follow backtest_rating.strategy_section (daily NaN returns as 0; drawdown over W_1..W_N); Sharpe uses ddof = 1; E4 restricts the full-period daily series to each half
I6 the stationary and moving-block bootstrap algorithms and seeds above
I7 the expanding-window composite includes month-end t and needs 60 values per member
I8 the partial Spearman is the partial correlation of average ranks, p with n_eff - 5
I9 Holm ties keep the order C01..C12, COMP
I10 the legacy reproduction uses the pinned CSV's score column at every month-end with Y(t,126)
These were fixed before unsealing and before any train-period outcome statistic was looked at; none depends on a train-period result
outputs: research/RESULTS.md and output/research/test/*: 13 primary tests (r, n, n_eff, 90% interval, raw and Holm p, pass/fail); F2-F7; train replication; composite economic test with benchmarks and E1-E4; secondary economic tables; all sanity checks; deviations; look-log summary; verdict in the registered words, including 'No timing signal found'
